decisions.decision: DEFAULT_BASE_POSITION is authoritative; do NOT use camera for base1
decisions.rationale: Operator decision based on observation that camera has mm-scale noise. Base is physically pinned at (0, -0.4, -0.0625).
Pure exploratory spiral can drift away from the hole. Bias keeps peg anchored. Generalizes: target_xy = hole_xy_prior if known, else CAD-derived predicted xy.

decisions.decision: Do NOT bake u_orange's 6mm slot offset into fmb_assembly1.json
decisions.rationale: Spiral should absorb it; tuning the JSON would mask a class of per-object variance the primitive needs to handle generally.
Post-cleanup retract holds whatever orientation the prior wedge ended in; tilt accumulates without re-rotation. Each rotate is ~3s and idempotent.
30 gives spiral enough budget to break through chamfer in pathological grasps. 12 was too aggressive a safety ceiling.

decisions.decision: Use module mode (python3 -m primitives.X) for ALL primitive subprocess invocations
decisions.rationale: Script-path mode (python3 primitives/X.py) fails silently with ModuleNotFoundError when primitives import siblings.

decisions.decision: Spike detection threshold 0.5 mm/s (lowered from initial 5 mm/s)
decisions.rationale: Successful breakthroughs have peak descent ~0.1-0.5 mm/s, not 5 mm/s. Initial threshold was orders too high.

blocking_constraints.name: Always use --already-held in loop attempts 2+
blocking_constraints.description: Skipping rotate_object between attempts lets EE tilt accumulate. Operator observed iter 7 had 4.7° pitch tilt after just a few attempts.
blocking_constraints.mitigation: loop_iterate enforces this; do not bypass with a 'wrapper-only' shortcut.

blocking_constraints.name: Module mode for primitive subprocess invocations
blocking_constraints.description: python3 primitives/X.py fails silently with ModuleNotFoundError. python3 -m primitives.X works.
blocking_constraints.mitigation: All callsites already converted; new code must follow.

blocking_constraints.name: Do not use camera for base1 pose
blocking_constraints.description: Camera has mm-scale noise; base is fixed. iterate_insert._config_base_pose() returns DEFAULT_BASE_POSITION from primitives/shared/config.py.
blocking_constraints.mitigation: Already wired; do not introduce a 'fall back to camera' path.

blocking_constraints.name: rotate_object IK cost threshold ≤ 0.025
blocking_constraints.description: Loosening this re-introduces the bug where IK returns current joints (with 5° pose error) as 'valid'.

blocking_constraints.name: Mode B action TYPE matters more than magnitude
blocking_constraints.description: Pushing harder Fz + cardinal pokes deepens peg-on-rim wedges. Verified empirically: 4 iterations × 12 corrections = ABORT each time.
blocking_constraints.mitigation: v3 spiral (retract + low-Fz search + lateral force/torque rotation + bias) replaces poke. Don't revert to poke mode without a strong reason.
